title: Composition for constructibility alone
statement:
If $\mathcal C(f)$ and $\mathcal C(g)$ hold for composable
morphisms, then $\mathcal C(gf)$ holds, for the predicate of
[def-finrepair-property-c].

proof.text: Fix composable $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ in the domain of [def-finrepair-property-c], and a constructible $\Lambda$-sheaf $F$ on $X_{\Et}$. The coefficient ring is finite and commutative. For every $b\ge0$, $\mathcal C(f)$ makes $R^bf_*F$ constructible on $Y_{\Et}$; applying $\mathcal C(g)$ to this sheaf makes $R^ag_*(R^bf_*F)$ constructible on $Z_{\Et}$ for every $a\ge0$. This is just the two quantified hypotheses in [def-finrepair-property-c], applied successively. Use [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] to pass from the finite-constant-value predicate to IsConstructibleSheaf. Identify higherDirectImage with the ordinary nonnegative right derived functor by Functor.homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso.

source.place: Proof, first sentence: constructibility of the E_2 terms

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-spectral-sequence] to the two scheme morphisms and the commutative ring $\Lambda$. It supplies a spectral sequence of $\Lambda$-module sheaves on $Z_{\Et}$ with $E_2^{a,b}=R^ag_*R^bf_*F$, zero terms outside the first quadrant, $d_r$ of bidegree $(r,1-r)$, and $E_{r+1}$ equal to the cohomology of $d_r$. Its abutment in degree $n$ is $H^n=R^n(gf)_*F$, with a finite filtration whose graded pieces are $E_\infty^{p,n-p}$. No acyclicity hypothesis on the constructible sheaf $F$ and no uniform cohomological-dimension bound are required by the cited statement. In Lean use the proved source declaration exists_grothendieckSpectralSequence_lowerStar directly; its abutment is the right derived functor of the composite of the two underived functors.

proof.text: Induct on the integer $r\ge2$ to show that every term $E_r^{a,b}$ is constructible. For $r=2$ this is step 1 in the first quadrant; outside it the terms are zero, which is finite locally constant on the single stratum $Z$. Suppose all terms of $E_r$ are constructible. For any bidegree put $K=\ker(d_r:E_r^{a,b}\to E_r^{a+r,b-r+1})$. The kernel clause of [thm-constructible-serre] makes $K$ constructible. Since $d_r^2=0$, the incoming differential factors through $K$, giving $E_r^{a-r,b+r-1}\to K$. The cokernel clause of [thm-constructible-serre] makes its cokernel constructible. This cokernel is $E_{r+1}^{a,b}$ by the page-cohomology formula of [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-spectral-sequence]. Thus the induction advances. Only kernels and cokernels of morphisms between constructible sheaves have been used; no closure under arbitrary subsheaves is assumed. The private helper constructible_homology uses ShortComplex.homologyIsoCokernelLift, and constructible_page implements simultaneous Int.leInduction over all bidegrees.

source.place: Tag 03RZ, lemma-constructible-abelian (3), kernel and cokernel clauses; page-cohomology formula as supplied by the relative Leray sequence, Tag 0734

proof.text: Fix $n\ge0$. For each $0\le p\le n$, choose an integer $r>\max(p,n-p+1)$. The stabilization assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-spectral-sequence] identifies $E_\infty^{p,n-p}$ with $E_r^{p,n-p}$, so step 3 makes this graded piece constructible. The same cited statement gives $H^n=F^0H^n\supseteq\cdots\supseteq F^{n+1}H^n=0$ and $F^pH^n/F^{p+1}H^n\cong E_\infty^{p,n-p}$. Descend on $p$ from $n+1$ to $0$: the base $F^{n+1}H^n=0$ is constructible; if $F^{p+1}H^n$ is constructible, the short exact sequence $0\to F^{p+1}H^n\to F^pH^n\to E_\infty^{p,n-p}\to0$ and the extension clause of [thm-constructible-serre] make $F^pH^n$ constructible. Hence $H^n$ is constructible. As $n$ and $F$ were arbitrary, this is $\mathcal C(gf)$ by [def-finrepair-property-c]. The bound on $r$ depends on the bidegree; the argument never bounds all higher direct images at once. In Lean pageInfinity (p,q) is defined at page p+q+2, so no further stabilization isomorphism is needed. The private helper constructible_abutment descends the subobject filtration using Nat.decreasingInduction and the short exact sequence of a monomorphism and its cokernel. Transport along lowerStarComp, its induced right-derived isomorphism and homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso identifies the abutment with higherDirectImage of the composite. Transfer back using [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison].
